additional_info.subject: 0472451 - ID0472451-DC/Si-D/SE- [Y2/S3313581528002] Locking Mechanism does not Lock CRM:00472000522
additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
I'm writing to provide an important update regarding the availability of the locking mechanism for our chargers.
Historically, when a locking mechanism needed replacement, we were able to supply these parts from chargers that had been scraped from the factory. This allowed us to quickly address service needs without formally stocking the locking mechanism as a spare part.
However, we've now reached a point where we no longer have a supply of these components from scraped factory chargers. This means we can no longer fulfill requests for the locking mechanism using our previous method.
I've already discussed this situation with the serviceability team, and they are actively working on a solution to ensure these parts become available in stock. We understand the importance of having these components readily accessible for service and maintenance, and we're committed to finding a sustainable solution.
We will keep you informed of their progress and any timelines for when these parts are expected to be available through our standard spare parts channels.
Thank you for your understanding and patience as we work through this.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com

additional_info.body:
Hello Magnus,
This email provides a correction to the previous information shared regarding the availability of the locking mechanism for our chargers.
It has come to my attention that the previous update was incorrect. I am pleased to inform you that the spare part you require, 8EM5905-0AA01-2AA0 - Bowden cable switch Sicharge D housing, is indeed available in our spare parts list.
Given that the correct spare part is now confirmed as available, I will proceed with closing the associated ticket. Please feel free to place your order through our standard spare parts channels.
Thank you for your understanding.
